title: Prediction as a Child of Modernity
coreMove: Replace prediction pride with exposure mapping when the domain is too opaque for clean forecasts.
sourcePressure: This chapter criticizes forecast prestige in opaque domains and shifts attention to payoff, exposure, and humility.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Thinking the lesson is to stop learning or stop estimating altogether.

sourceAnchors.name: prediction prestige
sourceAnchors.detail: the chapter treats forecasting confidence as a modern habit that often outruns reality in uncertain domains
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: The forecast sounds adult until the payoff table asks who gets hurt when it is wrong.

sourceAnchors.name: payoff realism
sourceAnchors.detail: the source notes shift attention from forecast accuracy to exposure
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: When the map is cloudy, the first honest question is what each wrong turn costs.
